## Outcome

Qualify agent evidence release and positioning limits.

Epic: https://github.com/atulsrivas1/equity-features/issues/195 | Release: R11 | Provisional story points: 5 (complexity, not days).
Dependencies: EQ-106–EQ-109, EQ-100, EQ-105, EQ-084 for hosted scope. Existing release gates apply. Status: Backlog; no implementation authorized by planning alone.

## Start and design

Read accepted result/availability/adapter contracts and dependency receipts; publish the pre-code plan, freeze public schemas and hand-derived cases, then implement the smallest public API demonstration. Separate calculation, acquisition, storage and orchestration responsibilities.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Release receipt covers service threat model, access isolation, replay, ledger limits, compatibility and examples; messaging states reproducible evidence and declared checks, not compliance certification or unique-market claims.
- [ ] Independent tests and documented limits pass on the final reviewed commit.
- [ ] Public API/schema, examples, decision/migration guidance and delivery receipt updated alongside code.
- [ ] Follow Backlog → Ready → In progress → Code review → Test → Ready to release → Released → Done with actual gates and post-delivery verification.

## Required tests

Installed artifacts, MCP end-to-end, tamper/replay/isolation failure tests and supported-platform checks.

## Open design questions

Local/hosted release scope and future independent security assessment. Settle in the pre-code plan; do not silently assume guarantees.

## Documentation and accepted end state

Update docs/EVIDENCE_ROADMAP.md, relevant API/contracts, synthetic installed examples, compatibility/security/rights guidance and SESSION_HANDOFF.md. End state: a qualified experimental capability with linked acceptance and reproducible delivery evidence; source truth, profitability and regulatory compliance are not certified.

review_history.ADMIT01: First pre-execution source review identified a missing fresh candidate-ref check; direct canonical git/ref equality was added before execution. The initial saved report/source captured the corrected guard after a coordination race; its subset probe omitted that standalone guard and is not evidence of a vulnerable current full controller. Initial and final reports remain preserved; final complete-source controls passed. No incorrect admission occurred.
review_history.ADMIT02: Pre-execution downstream review found that the admission comment step preceded the final original-body readback. Added a distinct successful completion marker after actual body/state/Atul readback; the docs preparer requires that final marker and refuses an earlier partial comment step. No incomplete admission was consumed.
review_history.CI01: New EQ110 capture initially called an unchanged gate hardcoded to the old EQ109 branch/PRs. Prepared a parameterized EQ110 gate with explicit actual branch/PR identities; exact separate review is mandatory before capture. Original EQ109 gate and accepted evidence stay unchanged. No real CI failure was inferred from this unexecuted adapter defect.
review_history.COLLECT01: The new EQ110 collector initially inherited an unescaped filename-regex dot. Changed to a literal .json suffix before any collector use; old EQ109 collector/evidence unchanged. No workspace escape, runtime bug or failed download was inferred.
review_history.EQ110PREP01: Pre-execution reviewer found Git branch lookup errors accepted as absence. Corrected to exact returncode1 before either checkout mutation; original source and initial report retained.
review_history.FIN01: Final actual working-doc review found an impossible sequence requiring all seven milestone members/zero open before closing the included open epic. Corrected both current handoff prefixes: first verify five stories plus GOV023 Done; finish/close the epic through its remaining lifecycle; then verify all exact seven Closed/Done/zero open before milestone closure. Earlier prepared semantic review missed this wording; its initial/final reports and exact failed-prefix capture remain preserved.
review_history.NAV01: Prepared navigation review found that replacing the stale MCP introduction would remove four direct contract/oracle/admission/validation links. All four explicit relative links were restored in the timeless replacement before repository writes; original prepared text and initial review remain preserved.
review_history.PUB01: Pre-execution delivery publisher review moved original-body marker/tail validation before any commit, push, PR or lifecycle mutation; the original late guard source/report are preserved. No malformed actual issue or executed publication failure was claimed.
review_history.RECP01: Prepared receipt conflated absent retained input unavailable0 with valid unavailable-quality replay possible matched1; corrected before packet/publication. Advisory unknown policy and <=128ASCII bound clarified. Original draft/review retained.

scope: EQ110 documentation-only implementation candidate; no aggregate acceptance or runtime change.

scope_decision.external_human_security_assessment: deferred; none performed; future trust expansion requires its own admission
